normalized.result: Yes, that's the right duplicate rule. That tracked link is really just the same MDN grid page dressed up with newsletter tracking tags on the end and a jump to a section — it's not a different page, so pasting it correctly pointed me at the clean bookmark I already have instead of making a near-identical second copy. That's exactly the kind of thing I'd want it to see through; otherwise I'd end up with the "same" link saved three times just because one came from an email and one had a #examples on it. Treating those as the same destination is right. Good.
